name: retrocpu-emu
description: MN1613 Retro CPU Emulator (Electron IO Board)

scripts.start: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron .
scripts.start:mn1613: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron . mn1613.jsonc
scripts.start:tms9995: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron . tms9995.jsonc
scripts.dev: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron .
